about: Numbers the native renderer uses to read Sonic's motion and place him. Each row becomes one C++ constant.

rows.purpose: how long the boost trail lingers behind Sonic (x the lab's Trail length)
boost trail width next to Sonic (it tapers toward the tail)
lightning bolts crackling around a boosting Sonic (x the lab's Lightning)
sun height (sine of its elevation) below which the projected shadow gives way to the soft one
height above the ground at which Sonic's shadow has faded out
shadow drawn this far above the ground
speed where Frontiers' relative-wind sound starts
speed where the wind is at full volume and highest pitch
least wind while boosting (on top of the speed share)
Frontiers rings on the ground, ring rewards and the ring counter (off for now, to come back later)
speed where the boost blur starts
speed where the boost blur is at its strongest
longest streak, as a share of the distance to the screen centre
share of the blur kept at speed when the boost key is not held
time for the boost aura to light up
time for the boost aura to go out
brightness of the boost aura
length of the flash and shock wave when a boost starts
size the boost-start shock wave grows to
Sonic's standing height in BeamNG's world
time constant smoothing his speed for animation
yaw rate that counts as a hard turn (drift while boosting)
how fast Sonic turns to face where he runs
how far Sonic leans into turns
near plane of the projection matching BeamNG's camera
master volume of Frontiers sounds
